dict.string: DuskShift uses your location and bundled offline time-zone boundaries to calculate local sunrise and sunset while traveling. If location is unavailable, it uses your saved manual city.
DuskShift uses your location and bundled offline time-zone boundaries to calculate local sunrise and sunset while traveling. If location is unavailable, it uses your saved manual city.
DuskShift needs to control System Events to switch system appearance at locally calculated sunrise and sunset times.
